# Studio One Hair Design

> Full-service hair salon in Fresno, California specializing in hand-tied beaded row
> extensions (NBR), custom hair color, medical wigs and toppers, and precision cutting.
> Owned by Cat Barco. Serving Fresno, Clovis, and the Central Valley.

## About
Studio One Hair Design is a boutique salon in Fresno, CA. The team specializes in
natural beaded row (NBR) hand-tied extensions, balayage and color correction, and
medical-grade wigs and toppers for clients experiencing hair loss. Consultations are
free and every service starts with a personalized plan.

- Address: 2950 E Nees Ave., #103, Fresno, CA 93720
- Phone: 559-795-9724 (call or text)
- Hours: Mon-Thu 10am-8pm, Fri 10am-7pm, Sat 10am-6pm, Sun closed
- Booking: https://www.studioonefresno.com/booking
- Instagram: @studioonefresno

## Services
- [Hair Extensions (NBR)](https://www.studioonefresno.com/nbr-extensions): Hand-tied beaded row extensions for length and volume.
- [No Sew Luxe Extensions](https://www.studioonefresno.com/no-sew-luxe-tm-extensions): A lighter, faster extension option installed with the 15-Minute Method.
- [Compare Extension Methods](https://www.studioonefresno.com/hair-extension-methods-fresno): Side-by-side comparison of beaded row and No Sew Luxe.
- [Hair Color](https://www.studioonefresno.com/hair-color-fresno): Balayage, highlights, all-over color, and color correction.
- [Wigs & Toppers](https://www.studioonefresno.com/wigs): Medical wigs and toppers, including consultations for hair loss and treatment-related loss.
- [Nically Hair](https://www.studioonefresno.com/nically-hair): The salon's in-house extension hair line.
- [All Services](https://www.studioonefresno.com/services): Complete service and pricing overview.
